facts.name: ETF 元数据（instruments_etf）
facts.sql: select count(*) as rows, count(distinct symbol) as symbols, count(distinct substr(symbol,1,3)) as prefixes from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/instruments_etf/instruments_etf.parquet') ; select substr(symbol,1,3) as prefix, count(*) as n from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/instruments_etf/instruments_etf.parquet') group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 8
facts.note: 有 1,769 条 ETF 代码表，但没有任何行情

facts.name: ETF 代码是否混在股票日线面板里
facts.sql: select count(distinct k.symbol) as etf_symbols_present_in_stock_kline from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily/**/*.parquet') k where k.symbol in (select symbol from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/instruments_etf/instruments_etf.parquet'))

facts.name: 股票日线面板中的 ETF 类代码前缀（51/15/56/58/16）
facts.sql: select substr(symbol,1,2) as prefix, count(distinct symbol) as n from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily/**/*.parquet') where substr(symbol,1,2) in ('51','15','56','58','16') group by 1 order by 1
facts.note: 空结果 = 面板里连一只 ETF 都没有

facts.name: 分钟线是否覆盖 ETF（全量 symbol 列扫描）
facts.sql: select count(distinct symbol) as symbols, count(distinct symbol) filter (where substr(symbol,1,2) in ('51','15','56','58','16')) as etf_like_symbols from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_minute/**/*.parquet')
facts.note: etf_like_symbols = 0 → 分钟线也只有股票代码，ETF 没有任何粒度的行情
